span.p:
h_v(0) = Linear(node_feat)
e_vw(0) = Linear(edge_feat)
g(0) = Linear(global_feat)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Layer l+1:
h_v(l+1) = h_v(l) + Sum_{w in N(v)} sigma(W * [h_w(l), e_vw(l), g(l)])
+ LayerNorm + Dropout(0.1)
